comparison.objective: Set a drill-press depth stop and prove the resulting depth twice.
comparison.physical_skill: One arm holds a catch open while the other adjusts a motion stop, followed by repeated downfeed testing.
comparison.success_condition: Two loaded strokes stop at the target depth and return repeatably after release.
comparison.reason: Both tasks test bimanual adjustment of a mechanical travel stop followed by repeated functional verification; the candidate’s jam nut and angular geometry add mechanism detail but not a clearly different overall tested ability.
